title: Samsung may launch Galaxy S27 series earlier than expected, but memory questions still linger
description: The Galaxy S26 series arrived late – the S24 generation was unveiled in mid-January and launched in late January, while the S25 generation was announced in late January and launched in early February. The S26 series was only made official in late February and came out in early March. The delay was likely caused by the last-minute switch from an S26 Edge to an S26+. The upcoming Galaxy S27 series may return to the usual January/February time frame, writes user Lanzuk on the Korean micro-blogging platform Naver. The exact timeline isn’t known yet, but, apparently, most major decisions over...

title: Redmi K100 with 10,000mAh battery and 6.83-inch display is launching next week
description: Xiaomi teased the arrival of the Redmi K100 in China last week. The company has now announced the phone’s launch date and revealed its key specs and design. It will join the K100 Pro and K100 Pro Max that were unveiled in August. The Redmi K100 will launch in China on October 28, the brand confirmed in an official post on Weibo. Alongside, Redmi also showcased the phone in a new Firefly Green colorway. It also confirmed that the phone will be powered by the Snapdragon 8 Elite chipset, paired with the company’s D2 display chipset. The phone will offer 165Hz refresh-rate in over 40...

title: Samsung Galaxy F70 arrives with familiar specs
description: Samsung’s latest F-series smartphone is now official in India with the launch of the Galaxy F70. This is the third entry in the F70 series, following the Galaxy F70e from February and the Galaxy F70 Pro, which launched in August. The new Galaxy F70 is the midpoint in the F-series and features plenty of similarities with last year’s Galaxy A17. Galaxy F70 is built around a 6.7-inch Super AMOLED display with FHD+ resolution and a 90Hz refresh rate. The panel is protected by Corning Gorilla Glass Victus and features a waterdrop notch for its 13MP front-facing camera. Around the back, we...

title: iQOO Neo12 set to launch on October 28, design and color options revealed
description: iQOO recently confirmed that its upcoming Neo12 will be powered by the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chipset and feature a 2K AMOLED display with a 185Hz refresh rate. The company has now revealed the phone’s design, color options, and launch date in China. The iQOO Neo12 will launch in China on October 28, with pre-orders already open in the country. The phone will be available in three color options called Fierce Edge, Shadow Black, and Frost Blade Blue. The Fierce Edge variant, as seen above, features a dynamic texture on the rear panel. iQOO has also confirmed that...

title: iPhone Duo's battery capacity officially revealed
description: Apple’s iPhone Duo went up for pre-order last week, with sales and deliveries set to begin later this week. Ahead of the launch, Apple has published the EU energy label for the foldable iPhone, revealing its battery capacity and endurance ratings. The official energy label lists a 4,883mAh lithium-ion battery for the iPhone Duo, which is split into two. According to the energy label, the iPhone Duo offers a rated battery endurance of 51 hours and 30 minutes per cycle. The battery is also rated to retain its performance for at least 1,000 charge cycles under default...

title: Honor Watch 6 review
description: Welcome to our Honor Watch 6 review. I know, I know, we're a little late with this one. Okay, maybe a lot late, but in our defense, some of that tardiness comes from battery testing a watch with more than a month's worth of endurance .(or so Honor promised). That may be the Honor Watch 6's key selling point, and for good reason: charging your smartwatch once a month is about as close to having a regular watch as you can get. But I'm here to tell you that there's more to the Honor Watch 6 than simply its huge battery. It's what a watch needs to be. Note that I didn't say smartwatch...

title: Apple AirPods 5 review
description: How do you update the most popular audio product in the world? That's a question that would keep many companies awake at night. But almost a decade after the original launched, Apple has kept the classic AirPods model relevant while turning it into one of the most profitable businesses ever. The 2026 AirPods 5 keep what people love while improving everything across the board. Better noise cancellation, better audio quality, better battery life, and even better gestures. title: What is variable aperture and why should you care?
description: The iPhone 18 Pro is the first iPhone model to feature a variable aperture, a headlining feature for this year's Pro models. An adjustable aperture has been an invaluable tool for photographers on professional and prosumer camera systems, and its absence from mobile cameras has become increasingly conspicuous as everything else on these devices has leveled up. There have been a handful of phones over the years that featured a variable aperture system for their main camera. However, the feature never stuck around long enough to enter the lexicon of the average smartphone user, as most...

title: OnePlus 16 is official with 9,000mAh battery, Week 42 in review
description: The OnePlus 16 is official, with a mammoth 9,000mAh battery. The power plant supports 100W wired and 50W wireless charging. Elsewhere on the phone, there's the latest Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 (still can't cope with this name), a 6.78-inch LTPO OLED display that can go up to 185Hz in select games, and a triple camera, consisting of a 200MP wide-angle, a 50MP 3x telephoto, and a 50MP ultrawide. The OnePlus 16 is available in China, and it's exclusive to China. Sadly, it isn't getting a global version. Still, that doesn't matter as much when you sell 70 thousand units in the first...

title: Apple iPhone 18 Pro vs. iPhone 17 Pro
description: We've got a new iPhone in town, but the age-old question remains: do I get the new iPhone, or is last year's model just as good? With the Apple iPhone 18 Pro now released, the Apple iPhone 17 Pro stock is running low as Apple has discontinued the model. However, if you act fast, you might find one that will feel just like the new iPhone, but at a lower price. After all, the upgrades this year are quite modest. description: The OnePlus 15 was the last global flagship from the company. Since it launched, OnePlus left the global market to focus only on India and China. One tipster claims that the company will launch the cheaper OnePlus 16R and that it “might” launch the full-fat 16 flagship too. description: Amazon’s Prime Big Deal Days soaked up almost all of the discounts last week, so there wasn’t much left over for the weekend. This week, however, we are seeing a return to form. description: One commenter under last week’s poll made an interesting point – the Samsung Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra starts at $1,400 for a 12/256GB model and this is without the keyboard, which is an extra $380. description: This is the vivo V80, yes, the same V80 we handled earlier this month. Well, different unit; this one is Green (or is it Blue?). We're torn whether it's a green shade of blue or a blue shade of green. Either way, it's much nicer (and original) than the iPhone shade of orange we handled last time. description: Last week, we covered Amazon’s Prime Big Deal Days and then the aftermath – some phones kept their promotional prices from the Prime sale even during the weekend, while others went back up.
